routeAssessment: Reused the proved universal CM scalar centralizer to obtain symmetry and scalar discrepancy, avoiding general bilinear-form classification. Reused adicComplete_polynomial_simple_root for X^2-u at 1, avoiding a new Newton/completeness development. Reused the original CM arithmetic extension, group generation by the CM kernel and real conjugation, and original coefficient residue maps. Residue identifications are unique over the original coefficient base. No extra general representability framework or replacement source model was introduced. For the unframed universal property, native framed universality supplies every lift, full polarized trace descent supplies a trace-ring representative, and native descended trace generation proves uniqueness of the coefficient map. This avoids proving a separate general equal-trace theorem for arbitrary polarized lifts. Only the actual source strict GL equivalence, its quotient classes and coefficient evaluation/naturality were added; a new category-theoretic representability framework was unnecessary. FLT has actual scalar-weight quaternionic evaluation proofs, which inform the route but do not directly instantiate the required arbitrary-rank unitary weight representation or auxiliary group-algebra trace. A shorter source-faithful construction uses pinned DoubleCoset.eq/out_eq, existing free regular representations, intertwining-to-module maps and native coinvariant maps. No general choice of double-coset sections, new category framework, period-ring foundation, or full external package port was needed.
